extracted.intended_audience: PC/Steam gamers and potential purchasers interested in Conan Exiles Enhanced
extracted.subtask_description: A Steam store product page listing a single video game (Conan Exiles Enhanced) with marketing copy, features, system requirements, languages, content warnings, reviews, pricing/discounts, and bundle information intended to inform purchase decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: System Requirements (Minimum)
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10 64bit. Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400F. Memory: 8 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or Radeon RX 580. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 115 GB available space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the minimum hardware/software specifications required to run the game; meeting them implies the game will run but with limited performance/visual fidelity. The page explicitly requires a 64-bit OS and lists 115 GB storage as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: System Requirements (Recommended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 11 64bit. Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5600X or Intel Core i7-11700F. Memory: 16 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 or Intel Arc A750. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 115 GB available space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These recommended specs are stated to achieve better performance/visuals; the page elsewhere claims target 60+ FPS on most PCs when upgraded to Unreal Engine 5, implying recommended specs align with that target.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product Features / Mode Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature list including: Single-player, Online PvP, Online Co-op, Steam Achievements, Steam Trading Cards, Steam Workshop, Remote Play on Tablet, Remote Play on TV, Family Sharing, Requires agreement to a 3rd-party EULA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This enumerates the gameplay modes and Steam platform features supported by the product; useful criteria for buyers who require specific multiplayer modes, achievement support, mod integration, or platform features (Remote Play, Family Sharing). The EULA requirement is a legal/usage precondition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages and Localization Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Languages: English and 11 more. Interface / Full Audio / Subtitles availability broken out per language (e.g., English: interface, full audio, subtitles; French: interface and subtitles; see all 12 supported languages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists which languages have full audio, interface text, and subtitles; important for players who need localized audio/interface/subtitles. The page provides a per-language breakdown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content / Mature Content Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Developers describe content: 'Conan Exiles has brutal combat where you can cut off limbs and heads of human opponents and blood is shown frequently. Players may choose to play the game with either no, partial or full nudity enabled. This is possible in both single and multiplayer.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit content and player-configurable nudity settings are called out. This serves as a content-warnings rubric for suitability (age/maturity) and for users who want to disable or enable nudity. The violent dismemberment note signals mature audience requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive Elements / Online Interactivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes Interactive Elements: In-game purchases, In-game chat, Online interactivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the game contains social/online systems and microtransactions, which affect privacy, social exposure, and potential ongoing costs. Buyers who want offline-only experiences or no in-game purchases should consider this.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Reviews & Aggregated Review Metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Review summaries shown: Recent Reviews: Mostly Positive (1,168) - 77% of the 1,168 user reviews in the last 30 days are positive. English Reviews: Mostly Positive (38,044) - 79% of the 38,044 user reviews for this game are positive. All Reviews: 113,293 (79% positive overall for English). Language-specific breakdowns and filters are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The store uses aggregated review scores and language/time filters to convey community sentiment. This is presented as a decision metric for prospective buyers; the page also provides tools to filter and view 'Most Helpful', 'Recent', and 'Funny' reviews and to toggle off-topic review filtering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Popular User-Defined Tags
rubrics_metrics.description: Popular user-defined tags for this product: Survival, Open World, Nudity, Building, Open World Survival Craft, Crafting, Multiplayer, Sandbox, RPG, Massively Multiplayer, Adventure, Action, Online Co-Op, Exploration, Singleplayer, Co-op, Fantasy, Violent, Gore, PvP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tags indicate community-identified genres and features; users can use them to determine whether the game's mechanics and themes match their preferences (e.g., survival vs. pure RPG, presence of nudity or gore).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing, Discounts, and Bundles
rubrics_metrics.description: Displayed pricing and promotions: e.g., MIDWEEK DEAL! Offer ends May 18 -25% $39.99 $29.99 for Standard Edition. Bundles: Complete Edition includes 13 items (list provided) with discount percentages (e.g., -47%, -44% shown), and other bundles (Isle of Siptah Edition, The Conan Bundle) with pricing and discount breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides time-limited discounts and bundle deals; buyers are informed of savings percentages and bundle contents. Pricing information is a decision criterion and includes explicit offer end dates when present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Game Selling Points / Technical & Visual Upgrades
rubrics_metrics.description: Marketing claims: 'Conan Exiles Enhanced brings the entire game into Unreal Engine 5 with significantly improved visuals across environments, characters, lighting, and effects. It unifies eight years of content into a single upgraded experience, connects The Exiled Lands with the Isle of Siptah, boosts performance to target 60+ FPS on most PCs, improves Steam Deck play, adds numerous quality‑of‑life upgrades, and introduces a redesigned UI.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes technical/visual improvements and performance targets that buyers may use to evaluate the value of this 'Enhanced' edition versus prior releases. These are claims rather than verifiable requirements; users may cross-check with reviews or benchmarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gameplay Pillars and Mechanics
rubrics_metrics.description: Core gameplay descriptions: 'SURVIVE, BUILD, and DOMINATE alone or with friends' — details include surviving weather, building shelters/cities, crafting weapons/tools, combat (combo-based system), thrall enslavement, dark sorcery mechanics, dungeon exploration, and summoning towering avatars of deities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This summarizes the primary gameplay systems and goals (survival mechanics, building systems, PvP sieges, thrall mechanics, sorcery). Players evaluating whether they will enjoy the game should compare these pillars to personal preferences (e.g., base-building vs. story-driven play).

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiplayer Server Control & Customization
rubrics_metrics.description: Server administrator tools: 'When playing alone locally or on a server you are the administrator of your world, with access to a range of in-game tools. Change your progression speed, spawn monsters, turn yourself invisible, deactivate avatars, and much more. Be the dungeon master of your own server.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the extent of server-side customization available to hosts; this is a criterion for players who want private-server control or role-playing/dungeon-master-style experiences. It highlights tunable parameters and admin powers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mod Support and Creation Tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Play with mods: 'Download Conan Exiles Enhanced mods directly from the Steam workshop to customize your game experience. You can also download the custom Conan Exiles Unreal Editor and start creating your own.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates official support for community mods and provision of a modding editor; a key criterion for players who value modability and custom content creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achievements & Points Shop Items
rubrics_metrics.description: View Steam Achievements (36). View Points Shop Items (20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the presence and quantity of Steam Achievements and Points Shop items; useful for completionist players or those who use Steam's points system to redeem items. Quantitative counts are given.
